text:
sam_partners: Quick sync: running a 1-day tooling interop validation focused on LangChain/LlamaIndex adapters + gateway auth for marketplace + on-prem bundles. Need owners for test vectors, packaging, and HW checks.

ivy_pm: I can take packaging and announcement checklist. Will need sample copy and partner logos by Wed.

omar_eng: I'll own test vectors & harness. Propose a tiny deterministic suite: gen baseline, function call, embed+retrieve. Keep each <20s.

lina_sre: Infra: request ephemeral GPU pool (1 a10, 1 g4dn) and a trace endpoint. Also need a short retention policy for traces (48h).

sam_partners: Good. Minimal tests: 1) text gen smoke, 2) function-calling with deterministic schema, 3) embedding + LlamaIndex retrieval check. Add GPU driver validator for on-prem.

omar_eng: Example function test payload I'll add to harness:

{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Return today's summary"}],"functions":[{"name":"summary","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{}}}]}

omar_eng: For retrieval I'll include 3-doc fixture and expected doc ids.

ivy_pm: Packaging note: marketplace images need a small healthcheck endpoint and manifest. On-prem bundles also need install.sh and driver check docs.

lina_sre: Driver check we plan to run:

python -c "import torch; print(torch.cuda.is_available())"
/usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc --version

build-bot: build-bot: Reminder: validation window 1716664500-1716664800 reserved for cluster maintenance. Schedule around it.

sam_partners: Proposed timeline: harness + fixtures by Tue EOD, packaging checklist Thurs, partner dry-run next Mon. Replies with blockers here.

omar_eng: Starting PR for harness now, will ping when CI green.

ivy_pm: I'll draft announcement checklist and post link once ready.
